fusions.name: Fair Copy
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second recital, looses 3 bolts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 14 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: The Last Word
fusions.desc: A spoken bolt that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Fluent Recital
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Committed to Memory
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 8%.
